# Hello! Xin Chào!

I’m Le-Huynh Truc-Ly, an environmental health researcher using data, statistics, and R to understand how environmental exposures impact human health. 
I use R to build open-source tools, automate research workflows, and turn complex data into clear visuals because science should be open, and life is too short for repetitive tasks!  
When I’m not hanging out with dataframes, you’ll find me sketching or cooking.
This site is a home for my research, projects, random thoughts, and technical notes from my coding journey. 
Most posts are personal notes to my future self, who I’m sure has forgotten many things.
*P.S. Hey, future me! Debugging code again? Read this site before setting your computer on fire!*
